title: A Threat Within
acceptText: Hey there, $N. Good to see a fresh face. Northshire is crawling with kobolds and wolves, and the Marshal needs every able $C he can get.$B$BHead into the abbey and report to Marshal McBride. He'll tell you where to start.
completeText: Willem sent you? Good. We could use a $Glad:lass; with some fight in $Ghim:her;. Welcome to Northshire.

title: Your Place In The World
acceptText: Lok'tar, $N. Every $R who comes to the Valley of Trials must prove their worth to the Horde.$B$BGo north to the den and find Gornek. He will see what you are made of.
completeText: So, Kaltunk sent another one. Good. We will soon see if you are strong enough to stand with us.

title: The Balance of Nature
acceptText: Ishnu-alah, $N. The balance of Shadowglen is fragile. The young nightsabers have grown too many, and they threaten the grove.$B$BThin their numbers, $C, and return to me when it is done.
progressText: Have you restored the balance of the grove, $N?
completeText: You have done well. Elune watches over you, young $Gbrother:sister;.

title: Dwarven Outfitters
acceptText: Well met, $N! Ye'll freeze solid out here dressed like that. Bring me some meat and hides from the wolves in the valley, and I'll see ye properly outfitted.
progressText: Still no hides? Those wolves won't skin themselves, $C.
completeText: Now that's fine work! Here, put this on before ye catch yer death of cold.

title: Rude Awakening
acceptText: You are awake at last, $N. Do not be alarmed. You have been chosen to serve the Dark Lady.$B$BGo outside and find Shadow Priest Sarvis. He will tell you what is expected of you.
completeText: Another one rises. Good. The Forsaken have need of every $R willing to fight.
